paper.title_en: String charge density/bit threads correspondence and its S-duality in type IIB supergravity
paper.abstract_en: We identify the spatial projection of a conserved string charge density with a bit-thread flow. This correspondence gives bit threads a string worldsheet description and allows us to compute black hole entropy from the maximal entropy flux of a worldsheet-derived current. We first reproduce the BTZ entropy and then extend the construction to the ten-dimensional F1-NS5-P and D1-D5-P systems. Under Type IIB S-duality, the F1 current maps to the D1 current. Although the local currents, metrics, and flow norms change, the maximal physical flux remains unchanged and gives the same entropy. This provides a nontrivial check of the correspondence. Finally, we propose a D1-D5 boundary-matching conjecture. In the coarse-grained picture, each string-charge line defines an entropy-carrying tube. The boundary CFT entanglement entropy and the bulk black hole entropy both fix the product of the number of tubes and the maximum entropy carried by each tube. For a fixed tube discretization, they assign the same capacity to each tube. They therefore describe the same conserved maximal entropy flux, providing an information-flow interpretation of the equality between entanglement entropy and black hole entropy.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将守恒弦荷密度的空间投影与比特线程流相对应，为比特线程提供弦世界面描述，并用世界面导出的流的最大熵通量计算黑洞熵；先在BTZ中复现熵，再推广到十维F1-NS5-P与D1-D5-P系统，并检验IIB S-对偶下最大物理通量与熵的不变性，最后提出D1-D5边界匹配猜想。理论构造清晰、对偶检验具有非平凡性，与黑洞热力学及全息熵的主题高度相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 弦荷密度/比特线程对应及其在IIB型超引力中的S-对偶
decision.abstract_zh: 我们将守恒弦荷密度的空间投影与比特线程流相对应。这一对应赋予了比特线程一个弦世界面描述，并使我们能够从世界面导出的流的最大熵通量计算黑洞熵。我们首先重现了BTZ熵，然后将该构造推广到十维的F1-NS5-P和D1-D5-P系统。在IIB型S-对偶下，F1流映射为D1流。尽管局域流、度规和流通量范数发生变化，最大物理通量保持不变，并给出相同的熵。这为该对应提供了一个非平凡的检验。最后，我们提出了一个D1-D5边界匹配猜想。在粗粒化图像中，每条弦荷线定义了一个携带熵的管。边界CFT纠缠熵和体黑洞熵都确定了管数与每个管所携带的最大熵的乘积。对于固定的管离散化，它们给每个管分配相同的容量。因此，它们描述了相同的守恒最大熵通量，从而为纠缠熵与黑洞熵之间的相等性提供了一种信息流解释。
